description: track-pending-tests.js hook flags source files that lack a matching test file. Tests must be at <src-dir>/<name>.test.ts (same dir) OR <src-dir>/__tests__/<name>.test.ts (adjacent __tests__/), NOT at a package-level __tests__/ that mirrors the source tree. Tests placed at packages/<pkg>/src/__tests__/<subpath>/<name>.test.ts do NOT clear the debt even though vitest finds them. Hook tracker is also sticky: a source file deleted via bash rm remains flagged until a matching test file is written at the tracked path, so prefer Edit-style relocations over delete+rewrite when restructuring.
resolution: Always co-locate the test next to the source as <src-dir>/__tests__/<name>.test.ts. If you must restructure, plant a placeholder test at the legacy tracked path until the tracker clears, then remove it in a follow-up commit.
